audit.whatIsWrong: This page's chart (Skill/Kled/Kled/Skill/Skill/Kled/Kled) disagrees with the already-audited mirror, which settled on Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill/Zac/Zac. It also gave Kled the first-item row while calling Zac the two-item winner, which is inconsistent with his own tank spike.
audit.why: Restating the mirror's finding from this side: Kled's mounted stat bar owns Level 1 through 4-5 before Cell Division blobs matter, Level 6 is a wash, and Zac takes over from his first tank item onward as blob reabsorption undoes short trades.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill/Zac/Zac in both layers, matching the mirror exactly.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full pattern at 3, R at 6. Zac: Elastic Slingshot rank-ups (21s down to 9s), first tank item, two items.
audit.corrected: Spike windows kept; the first-item spike reattributed to Zac to match the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Zac ability is named in the full layer (packet defect), and the page never mentions Unstable Matter or the revive — the two parts of his kit that actually decide this matchup.
audit.why: Unstable Matter (W) is a 5s cooldown dealing a percentage of maximum health as magic damage, which is exactly what eats Skaarl's oversized health bar — so armour is the wrong buy and the short-trade window is between W casts. Elastic Slingshot (E) is 21s at rank 1, the longest punish window in his kit. Cell Division means fatal damage splits him into four bloblets that recombine into a revive, so the blobs are not only sustain, they are a second life bar.
audit.corrected: Unstable Matter, Elastic Slingshot and Cell Division named with cooldowns in the cooldown and interaction fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tells the reader that killing Zac is not the end of the fight.
audit.why: Cell Division revives him from surviving bloblets, so damage has to go onto the bloblets.

edits.before: Zac trades evenly at level 1 and his passive blobs heal poke, so neither of you owns this window.
edits.after: Mounted Skaarl's stat bar wins the level-1 exchange before Zac has any blobs to reabsorb.

edits.before: Eclipse/Trinity sheen plus your percent-max-HP Q shreds his tank bar in one short all-in.
edits.after: His first tank item plus blob reabsorption undoes the short trades your Eclipse spike wins.

edits.before: Eclipse/Trinity sheen plus Q percent-max-HP shreds Zac's big tank health bar in a short trade.
edits.after: Zac's first tank item lands and Cell Division blobs start refunding what your Eclipse spike shreds.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Elastic Slingshot (E), 21s at rank 1: his only engage and his escape. That gap is the lane. - Unstable Matter (W) is 5s and deals max-health magic damage — armour will not blunt it. - Cell Division blobs are his sustain; stand on them.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot (E) is 21s at rank 1 — engage and escape on one cooldown, so bait it and the lane is yours. Unstable Matter (W), 5s, is max-health magic damage: buy MR, not armour, and step out between casts.

edits.before: His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 21 seconds at rank 1, and it is his escape too. Commit the moment he spends it.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Cell Division also revives him from surviving bloblets — kill the blobs, not just the body.

notes: Chart taken straight from the already-audited mirror (zac__kled) rather than from the packet, which disagreed on rows 1, 4-5 and first item; the two directions now match. The mirror's notes also warn that 'Beartrap on a Rope' is misspelled as one word in 25 full-layer strings across Kled's data and that 'Chaaaaaaaaarge!!!' appears with a wrong number of a's — those are champion-wide string issues, not fixable from this matchup file, and none of the strings quoted in this proposal contain either form. One data caution: Zac's E carries a derived 'grounding' flag, but Riot's description says only that he launches himself forward, so no grounding claim was written.
